summary: Pre-market brief (fact layer 2026-09-03T10:37:08Z): composite risk score 45.32, +0.08 on the day, +0.63 on the week and +2.85 on the month, still caution with regime goldilocks at model confidence 0.9234. Overnight, volatility was the only thing that really moved: VIX 14.92 to 16.34 (+1.42) while the composite added just 0.08. Credit barely noticed (HY OAS 2.63 to 2.65, IG OAS 0.8 to 0.81) and breadth did not move at all (above MA200 0.6129, new highs 0.0194, new lows 0.0516), so this reads as positioning into tomorrow's payrolls rather than a credit event. The front end led again: 2Y 4.34 to 4.39 against 10Y 4.75 to 4.79, leaving the curve at 0.4, with the real rate pinned at 2.44 (99.28th percentile) and FedWatch implying 3.96 as a hike. The Fed's own Beige Book describes growth narrowing to AI data centres with sticky inflation and K-shaped consumption, while Williams calls inflation slowly declining and rates at a good level. Equity leadership narrowed to the AI hardware leader: NVDA +3.2055 and MU +2.4254, while Broadcom's record FY2028 guide could not lift AVGO -0.66; the software complex kept funding it (AI Software -2.8709, Cybersecurity -2.7651, Enterprise Software -2.5994). The A-share close was a bounce inside a weekly downdraft: 688825.SH +2.2644 but 603986.SH -1.4555 and 301308.SZ -0.737, all three still -6.0386, -6.8093 and -6.8919 on the week. Crypto firmed (BTC 77586.0, ETH 2395.15, SOL 100.15) and oil is back above 92 on WTI per CLS relay, an inflation channel worth watching but not yet in the structured fact layer.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The real rate stayed pinned at 2.44, the 99.28th percentile, and contributed 4.964 to the composite — the single largest macro constraint and it did not ease overnight.
The front end led the sell-off again: 2Y 4.34 to 4.39 against 10Y 4.75 to 4.79, flattening the curve to 0.4, with FedWatch implying 3.96 as a hike that Williams explicitly refuses to endorse.
Volatility repriced without credit confirmation: VIX 14.92 to 16.34 (+1.42) against HY OAS moving only 2.63 to 2.65, so the option market is hedging an event, not pricing stress.

The AI trade narrowed to its leader: NVDA +3.2055 and MU +2.4254 while AVGO -0.66 despite a record FY2028 guide, and the software complex was sold again (AI Software -2.8709, Cybersecurity -2.7651, Enterprise Software -2.5994).
Participation stays thin and semis relative sits at -20.0029: new highs 0.0194 against new lows 0.0516, breadth above MA200 0.6129 — the index level rests on very few names.

supporting_signals.claim: No technical damage: price vs MA200 +7.5987, 52W drawdown -1.6352 and 3M momentum +1.4478 all still sit on the benign side of the trend dimension (45.67).
Credit and realized vol refuse to confirm the VIX move: HY OAS 2.65 (3.69th percentile), IG OAS 0.81 (36.56th) and realized vol 7.3736 (risk score 10.0).
Labour is still holding up: initial claims 203000 (from 207000), continuing claims 1778000 (from 1796000), unemployment 4.1 from 4.2.

contradicting_signals.claim: The Beige Book contradicts the goldilocks tag: growth is narrowing to AI data centres, inflation pressure stays stubborn and household stress is building (importance 56.21).
The inflation-shock leg has stalled: 10Y breakeven 2.35 to 2.34 and 5Y5Y flat at 2.33, with headline CPI 3.46353 to 3.30386 and core 2.56579 to 2.46652.
Risk appetite is not uniformly off: FinTech +3.0432, Digital Advertising +2.3045, EV Supply Chain +0.8498 and Autonomous Driving +1.5447 all closed higher on the day.

what_changed_today: Volatility was the only thing that really moved: VIX 14.92 to 16.34 (+1.42), while the composite risk score added only 0.08 to 45.32.
The front end led: 2Y 4.34 to 4.39 (+0.05) against 10Y 4.75 to 4.79 (+0.04), curve 0.4, real rate unchanged at 2.44.
Reserve plumbing kept draining: reverse repo 0.725 to 0.525 and the Fed balance sheet 6730912.0 from 6745699.0, leaving the RRP buffer at the 3.53rd percentile.

watch_next: Employment Situation on 2026-09-04T12:30:00Z (importance high), with payrolls already at -23.0 and unemployment at 4.1.
DOCU earnings on 2026-09-03T12:00:00Z (importance medium) — a read on enterprise software demand right after the sector's -2.5994 session.
PPI on 2026-09-10T12:30:00Z and CPI on 2026-09-11T12:30:00Z (both importance high) — the next test of the sticky-inflation claim in the Beige Book.
Whether VIX holds above 16.34 and HY OAS stays at or below 2.65; a break of either turns a positioning unwind into a risk event.

bull_case.title: AI hardware leadership holds and the vol spike burns out
points: Semis and data-centre infrastructure kept leading: Semis +1.104, Semiconductor Equipment +0.9024, Data Centers +0.7219, NVDA +3.2055 and +7.0352 on the week.
Credit gave no confirmation: HY OAS 2.65 sits in the 3.69th percentile and IG OAS 0.81 in the 36.56th, so funding stress is absent.
Disinflation resumed on the hard data: headline CPI 3.46353 to 3.30386 and core 2.56579 to 2.46652, keeping the real-rate ceiling from rising further.

base_case.title: Caution, with the AI trade narrowing to its leader
points: Composite risk 45.32 stays in caution under a goldilocks regime at 0.9234 model confidence, up only 0.08 on the day and 0.63 on the week.
Hardware leads and software funds it: Semis +1.104 and Semiconductor Equipment +0.9024 against AI Software -2.8709, Cybersecurity -2.7651 and Enterprise Software -2.5994.
The real rate at 2.44 (99.28th percentile) caps valuation, but HY OAS 2.65 and VIX 16.34 keep the repricing orderly.

bear_case.title: The front end breaks and thin breadth turns the rotation into a drawdown
points: Front-end-led tightening bites: 2Y 4.39 and 10Y 4.79 with the curve at 0.4 and the real rate at 2.44, while FedWatch implies 3.96 as a hike.
Participation is thin: new highs 0.0194 against new lows 0.0516, semis relative -20.0029 and cross-asset confirmation 0.375, so the index rests on a handful of names.

A-share AI names closed mixed (688825.SH +2.2644, 603986.SH -1.4555, 301308.SZ -0.737) but remain -6.0386, -6.8093 and -6.8919 on the week, while the Beige Book narrows US growth to AI data centres — one guidance miss propagates fast.
